title: Predicting First Round NFL Draft Picks
text:
The question
How well can NFL Combine measurements predict whether a player will be drafted in the first round? The intended audience is fans who want to see if their favorite players are likely to go in the first round. NFL teams could also use this analysis to see how much importance to place on certain Combine measurements. We will use NFL Combine data from the nflverse project, specifically using the nflreadr package. The dataset contains Combine measurements and draft information from 2000 through 2025. Each observation represents a player’s Combine record for a particular year, along with their draft information.
Our response variable is first_round, where 1 indicates that a player was drafted in the first round and 0 indicates that a player was drafted later or went undrafted. Potential predictors include height, weight, position, 40-yard dash time, vertical jump, broad jump, bench press, shuttle time, and three-cone drill time. One limitation is that many players have missing Combine measurements, which could affect our analysis.
